alerts.title: Clear dark sky tomorrow 3am
alerts.body: 92% clear for about 3 h from 3am, moon 6% lit. Try Prineville Reservoir State Park (International Dark Sky Park) (~200 km away).

alerts.title: Colourful sunrise likely tomorrow 6:54am
alerts.body: 69% odds of colour. Best bets: Milo McIver Memorial Viewpoint, Scout pick: Sunrise behind Mt. Hood from the McIver viewpoint, Columbia Hills

alerts.title: Sea of fog Sun Nov 8 6:56am
alerts.body: 100% chance the valley fills with fog at sunrise. Get above it: Silver Star Mountain, Larch Mountain: Sherrard Point.

weekend.title: Cackling Goose at Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge
weekend.body: Peak season: Cackling Goose records here are at 95% of their yearly high this week. Go early; dawn and the first two hours are best.

weekend.title: California Gull at Hamilton Creek & Ives Island chum salmon
weekend.body: Peak season: California Gull records here are at 97% of their yearly high this week. Go early; dawn and the first two hours are best.

weekend.title: Fall colour near peak at Sandy River Delta (Thousand Acres)
weekend.body: Sentinel-2 shows the trees here near peak as of 11-04. Shoot under soft overcast or in the first sun.
